council_revisions.hard_stop: x32 ABI reports AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64 (not a foreign audit arch) and is distinguished by __X32_SYSCALL_BIT in seccomp_data.nr; the arch gate alone did not kill x32-encoded bind/listen.
council_revisions.resolution: Folded a mandatory second guard: on an AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64 frame, seccomp_data.nr & __X32_SYSCALL_BIT => SIGKILL (kills every x32-encoded syscall, x32 being outside the frozen envelope); corrected the false 'x32 killed by arch gate' claim; added an executable x32-numbered bind/listen regression. Re-froze plan_ref 6ffb206d and re-authorized.

council_revisions.hard_stop: fs-verity binds content-to-inode but still permits rename/unlink/link; a same-user writer could re-point a verified file's PATHNAME to an unauthenticated inode before ld.so/helper/trust-store opens it by path. Content immutability != pathname->inode binding.
council_revisions.resolution: Fold: measure each member on an open fd, attach that EXACT inode into a private mount namespace by fd/inode (open_tree+move_mount / file bind mount), mount the root MS_RDONLY+MS_NOSYMFOLLOW so directory membership is frozen (no rename/unlink/link re-point). Recorded the two distinct pins (content SHA-256 identity + fs-verity Merkle). Added rename/unlink-and-replace regressions for ld.so, DT_NEEDED lib, git/credential helper, CA input.

hard_stops: Per-invocation launcher authenticity: install-time bootstrap seals the launcher, but the native launcher is the sole pathname entrypoint and doctor accepts a stored receipt, so a day-2 invocation could exec a substituted launcher before any check.
Dossier governance-summary contradiction: the runner OBJECTIVE described a one-phase pivot (bootstrap performs active-plan pivot + v15 supersession), contradicting the two-phase DISCOVERY-001 ruling.
council_revisions.resolution: Plan: pylae-verify-bootstrap is the per-invocation entrypoint that live-verifies+seals+fexecve's the launcher every run (stored receipt is provenance not authorization; forged/stale receipt grants nothing); raw launcher never path-invoked; TCB-root-rewrite by same-user is out of PD-001 scope (ptrace-boundary consistent); added initial+subsequent-launch regressions; --disable-proto=throw. Runner: OBJECTIVE governance summary rewritten to the two-phase semantics (Phase A activation-deferred registration; Phase B atomic pivot + v15 supersession). Codex explicitly RATIFIED SPIKE-E6 + SPIKE-PD001 and both open questions.

council_revisions.hard_stop: pylae-verify-bootstrap, now the per-invocation first process (run-9 fold), runs before the launcher installs seccomp and was only identity-pinned -- not static/hermetic/filter-first/in the listener-capability closure. A digest proves identity, not absence of listener capability, so authentic-but-defective bootstrap code (or its dynamic loader closure) could open a listener before enforcement.
council_revisions.resolution: Fold: pylae-verify-bootstrap is now itself a static, hermetic, loader-independent artifact with a hand-audited filter-first _start that installs NO_NEW_PRIVS + the arch-gated inherited seccomp filter (+ fd scrub) BEFORE any listener-capable code, THEN verify-seal-fexecve's the launcher; it is in the executable/listener-capability closure + native-capability review + packaged-artifact ELF inspection (bootstrap-not-hermetic fails qualification). The filter, installed by this first artifact and inherited un-droppable, covers the launcher and all descendants from the first byte. Boot sequence updated to prepend pylae-verify-bootstrap; launcher runs already-under the inherited filter. Added BOOTSTRAP-FILTER-FIRST + bootstrap-not-hermetic regressions.

council_revisions.hard_stop: Consistency/overclaim cleanups from the run-9/run-10 folds: (1) both bootstrap AND launcher named 'sole entrypoint'; (2) boot-order said only the sandbox-builder runs before the authenticated root though bootstrap+launcher also do; (3) overclaim that the bootstrap's own filter protects an authentic-but-defective bootstrap before that filter is installed.
council_revisions.resolution: Fold: pylae-verify-bootstrap is the SOLE user-facing entrypoint (launcher is the env-scrub stage reached only through it); boot-order corrected to 'static bootstrap+launcher+builder all run before the root; guarantee = no DYNAMIC Node/interpreter/library byte before the root'; removed the retroactive-filter overclaim -- the only pre-filter code is the hand-audited static listener-free _start prologue (guarantee rests on its audited listener-freeness, PRE-FILTER regression), and the filter covers everything only AFTER the prologue installs it.
